criteria.name: Problem relevance

concern.text: no evidence of interviews, deployment observations ... controlled customer testing

built: An on-site user study on participants' own phones, in Bangla and English: do people understand the Pause and the “not sure” state, and would they stop?
Anonymous by design: no names or phone numbers, balanced random assignment of screen language and analyst view.

criteria.name: AI/ML depth
built: The full pipeline re-run on five independently seeded synthetic worlds.
Six distribution-shift tests: adaptive scammers, noisier labels, older mule wallets, half and double scam prevalence, smaller amounts.
A system ablation ladder: what each layer adds on top of the last.

criteria.name: Business impact

concern.text: Customer impact depends on an assumed 30–70% intervention rate.

built: An economic model that solves for the follow rate UVERA needs to break even, instead of assuming one.
Net benefit per million transfers at several follow rates, and a sensitivity analysis over every assumption.
The stated stop rate from the on-site study as a first real-world anchor.

criteria.name: Prototype
built: A closed loop: analyst decisions on cases feed the QR watchlist.

criteria.name: Innovation

concern.text: quantify whether linking and evidence generation actually improve analyst decisions beyond simple alert aggregation

built: Case Linker measured against naive alert aggregation on the same alerts.
A between-subject A/B analyst task in the user study: plain alert list vs linked cases.

criteria.name: Scalability
built: A scale-out deployment: several API replicas behind nginx, Postgres, Prometheus and Grafana (deploy/scale).
A load test of p50/p95/p99 latency against concurrency.

criteria.name: Responsible AI
built: Fairness by account tenure, before and after the fix.
Rotating signing keys, an append-only audit log, a model registry with SHA-256 checks and a PII guard for generated briefs.
